description: LinkedIn is a professional networking platform that also offers APIs for approved partner, marketing, recruiting, learning, compliance, and consumer integrations. Its developer portal lets organizations create apps and request access to LinkedIn products and permissions.
summary: LinkedIn exposes a documented REST API at `https://api.linkedin.com` for consumer, marketing, sales, talent, learning, compliance, and regulatory integrations, authenticated with OAuth 2.0 via a LinkedIn developer app; no public OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP endpoint or first-party CLI was confirmed on linkedin.com.
